title: Override script
description: Runs in the sandbox. Body receives `ctx` with record, previous, status, user, inputs, effects, propose, fail(message), log(...). It returns changed values and proposed effects; the platform checks and applies them in the save.

recordType.description: The record type it runs for

hook.description: When it runs: before a record is saved, while it is validated, after it is written, when a workflow step is asked for, from a record action button, or to shape a report

order.description: Scripts of the same record type run from the lowest order up

runAs.description: Role whose permissions read the inputs and apply the effects, instead of the person saving. Only organisation administrators may publish it

inputs.description: Data the platform loads before the run and passes as ctx.inputs; a script cannot look anything else up

related.description: Records a reference field of this record points to

field.description: Reference field of this record type

fields.description: Fields of the referenced record to load

lookups.description: Records of a type whose fields equal fields of this record, newest first

match.description: Field of the looked-up type, mapped to the field of this record its value must equal

settings.description: Organisation settings to load; never secrets or connector settings

balances.description: Ledger account and fund balances as of the save date. Only organisation administrators may publish a script that declares it

effects.description: What the script may propose. Absent means it proposes nothing

allow.description: Effect types the script may propose

accounts.description: Ledger accounts a journal may use; required to propose journals

maxTotalAmount.description: Most the journals of one run may total; required to propose journals

connectors.description: Http (send mode) or webhook connectors the script may call

recipients.description: Named fixed recipients from the organisation settings the script may notify

maxEffects.description: Most effects one run may propose

code.description: JavaScript run with ctx; call ctx.fail('message') to stop the save
